articles.summary: Defence organizations are turning to commercial innovation not simply because it is less expensive, but because it offers access to the speed, scale, and technological agility required to maintain operational advantage in an increasingly dynamic security environment. But the same supply chains that enable rapid innovation also create new vulnerabilities.
articles.title: Dual-Use Technology Is Reshaping Defence Procurement: What That Means for Electronics Assurance.

articles.summary: In this webcast, Sebastian Fischmeister explains the technology behind PowerFuzzer and how it combines AI-powered fuzzing with power side-channel analysis to assess firmware without requiring source code access.
articles.title: Webcast: The Technology Behind PowerFuzzer | AI-Powered Firmware Validation and Side-Channel Analysis
